_comment: Same shape as agile_engagement_blue/red (+2{p} for yellow): ATTACK_REACTION + target.filter ATTACK_CLASS_IN ['Warrior'] + MODIFY_ATTACK add, spelling copied from shipped wtr/pummel_red. GAP on clause 2 ('If it's defended by an attack action card, create an Agility token') - NOT expressible today, deliberately NOT authored rather than authored dead (full reasoning in agile_engagement_blue._comment): an INJECT_TRIGGER with inner ON_DEFEND is inert because combat.injected_triggers consumers (engine.py ~1414, ~1753) keep only ON_HIT/ON_DEAL_DAMAGE entries, and no condition can test 'the defending card is an Attack action card' outside the defense-recalc pass (DEFENDING_CARD_IS needs combat.defense_recalc_card; CARD_TYPE_IN is documented in DSL_REFERENCE but unimplemented in condition_types.py). Would become authorable as INJECT_TRIGGER {scope COMBAT, trigger {trigger_type ON_DEFEND, conditions [{type DEFENDING_CARD_IS, types [Action, Attack]}], effects [{type CREATE_TOKEN, token agility}]}} once those two generic gaps close; json/tokens/agility.json already exists.
